answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 5 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The quill chain is verified at intake and zenith publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 5 epochs old, anchored at a marble checkpoint. Repeating the trick 6 times costs 60 separate deposits and 9 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
